E1.runtime_oracle: production admission result plus received request audit, bound to exact target registration and approved policy
E1.boundary: Offline log replay is not fresh TDX/REPORTDATA/nonce/configuration admission. LOCAL_BINDING_REJECTED is not remote DENY. Full raw Quote/request/EAR export is not currently supplied by the deployment CLI; missing outer verification stays NOT_RUN.

E2.other_faults: same-container-restart jointly replaces process/network/listener; not a pure port-change ablation. New-container replacement uses normal launch/register with exact old/new evidence.
E2.milestone: named business phase plus at least three successful requests on each existing/new TLS lane
E2.oracle: remote_acceptance.check with receiver_audit full coverage, target binding and measured clock uncertainty

E3.boundary: Never erase Agent data to manufacture first enrollment. Missing counter series is UNKNOWN, not zero.

E4.boundary: No SPIFFE/key one-to-one binding. Holding another valid user key grants that key's actual application authority. Direct Agent-Agent collaboration remains outside this suite.

E5.boundary: API Goodput and Agent task success are distinct. Record capacity stops and tail sample counts.
